title: 2D prop or item
description: A single game item or prop as a clean 2D cut-out on a transparent background, for inventory, pickups and scene dressing.

guidance: One item or prop, whole and uncropped, centered with an even margin, in a three-quarter or front view.
Clear silhouette and readable material (wood, metal, cloth) at inventory size; detail supports the shape.
Transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no frame.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear subject and its role in the game.
The prompt states the style, framing and background the purpose requires.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a full scene).
The prompt names the material and the view so the prop reads at inventory size.
image_rubric: The image shows the subject the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.
No anatomical, perspective or structural errors that block the target use.
The prop is whole and centered with an even margin, with no second object.
The silhouette and material read at inventory size.
